title: THSTI Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 02 Research Associate I and Project Associate I, II Posts
description: The Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI) has released the official notification for 2026. Allotted 02 vacancies for Research Associate I and Project Associate I and II Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.E/ B.Tech, M.E/ M.Tech, M.Sc., or Ph.D. can grab this chance and apply for these posts. Here we have included more information about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for the THSTI Notificatio...
